pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Installs only the versioned libjxl and libjxl_cms runtime libraries for an older ABI, so that prebuilt packages linked against it keep working on a system carrying a newer media-libs/libjxl.
media-libs/libjxl encodes the ABI in its subslot, which means a single version of it can be installed at a time; this package fills the gap for binary consumers. No headers, pkg-config files or tools are installed, so nothing can build against it by accident.
